description: This file defines the UploadedFileInterface interface in the PSR-7 HTTP message standard, specifying methods for handling uploaded files in PHP HTTP requests.

classes.name: UploadedFileInterface
classes.description: Interface for a value object representing a file uploaded through an HTTP request, defining methods to interact with uploaded file data and operations.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns a StreamInterface instance representing the uploaded file as a stream.

methods.name: moveTo
methods.description: Moves the uploaded file to a specified target path, ensuring the original is removed post-operation.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the uploaded file in bytes or null if size is unknown.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Retrieves the error status associated with the uploaded file.

methods.name: getClientFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename sent by the client for the uploaded file.

methods.name: getClientMediaType
methods.description: Retrieves the media type sent by the client for the uploaded file.
